definition: Share of new users who complete the activation event within the configured window.
Median whole days from signup to activation among users who activate inside the window.
Revenue retained from the starting cohort after expansion, contraction, and churn. New logos are excluded. 1.0 means 100 percent.
Revenue retained from the starting cohort ignoring expansion.
Increase in MRR for an account that already had MRR above zero.
formula: current_mrr - prior_mrr where both months are positive and current is higher

definition: Decrease in MRR for an account that stayed above zero.
formula: prior_mrr - current_mrr where current is still positive

definition: MRR lost when an active account goes to zero.
Share of visitors who sign up. A signup without a page view still counts as a visit.
Share of signups who fire the activation event at any later time.
Share of activated users whose account has had positive MRR or who fired the paid event.
Bridge from starting MRR to ending MRR. New MRR includes reactivations.
formula: ending_mrr = starting_mrr + new_mrr + expansion_mrr - contraction_mrr - churn_mrr

definition: 0-100 score from usage recency, recent event volume, payment status, and MRR trend.
